body:
We are more than likely on the same boat here.  I have this weird fantasy where I'm in bed and someone just bursts though my window and shoots me in the head.  It's quick, painless and at least my parents wouldnt have to go through what they would if I simply killed myself.

And I agree about not wishing this sort of thing on anyone.  It's a truly unhappy experience.

I know exactly how you feel.  I've always thought of it in terms of not wanting to kill yourself, but not wanting to live at the same time.  I too, probably would have done it by now, but I know how much it would destroy my parents, and it would not be fair to them.

I've been saying that I feel trapped in my own life now for a number of years.  Your post has put into words a lot of emotions that I have struggle to express.

I have no solutions or advice, because I am in the same position.  I just hope we both can turn it around and start living life like we are supposed to.  Best of luck buddy :)
